verdict.rationale: Cline documents review and rollback of what its agents do: every edit appears as a diff you can review, modify, or revert, and every step gets checkpoints with one-click undo. Kanban adds per-card worktrees with auto-commit and diff review with inline comments. The automations themselves (cron-scheduled agents, skills) have no documented versioning, change review, or rollback, so the story is only covered at the output level. Missing for 10: versioning of scheduled-agent and skill definitions, review and rollback of automation configuration changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
